authority.pythonRole: pure consumer; this collector only reads and re-derives
authority.broadcast: not performed; no authorization was granted
authority.writes: none; both stores are opened with mode=ro

unitContract.signedPnl: signed hex integer in the borrow token's raw units; the human amount is the integer divided by 10 ** borrow_token_decimals
unitContract.ladderRow: amountRaw is a hex integer in the same raw units; amount is the human counterpart
unitContract.borrowPrincipal: the borrow amount in human units of the borrow token; the kernel derives it from the published capacity
unitContract.usdgValuation: the value of one WHOLE borrow token in raw USDG units; USDG has six decimals
unitContract.usdgIdentity: USDG is worth 10 ** usdg_decimals raw USDG by the stablecoin unit identity; no USDG/USDG pool is consulted
unitContract.fee: the pool fee is an integer on the Uniswap V4 1e-6 scale
unitContract.gas: the V4 quoter returns the amount and the gas estimate in separate words; the gas never enters the PnL unit

items.title: the USDG identity, ETH/WETH direction, token decimals, the borrow principal, the fee, the gas and the signed PnL form one raw/human unit contract, proved by Rust unit tests and by real review output, and a missing price fails closed

rustUnitTests.meaning: the USDG anchor uses the stablecoin unit identity and needs no USDG/USDG pool
a USDG-paired token is worth one USDG at the peg, in raw USDG units
the pool's token order does not change the valuation
a token without a USDG route has NO valuation - never a zero
a token without known decimals has NO valuation - never a zero
a route without a valuation fails closed instead of using a default rate
the threshold is denominated in raw USDG units
the V4 quote keeps the amount and the gas estimate apart
a measured loss is published as the signed PnL
an unsigned zero is never published as a measurement
the signed PnL travels with the reviewed route

items.note: the human values are re-derived from the stored raw fields and the decimals of the token library; a self-consistent but wrong decimals pair inside the review row cannot hide a mismatch because the review row is not trusted for the decimals

items.title: the ETH/WETH valuation direction and the token decimals are correct, and the USDG anchor uses the stablecoin raw-unit identity rather than a USDG/USDG pool

usdgIdentity.note: the USDG anchor is the stablecoin unit identity (10^usdg_decimals raw USDG); the kernel's identity_valuation returns it before any pool is consulted.  The identity is verified on every USDG-anchored loop the Manager published; the review selection did not pick a USDG-anchored loop, so the review-level count is reported separately instead of being claimed as reviewed

items.note: ETH and WETH are distinct tokens with distinct addresses and distinct valuations, so the valuation does not treat them as one asset; the USDG anchor is the unit identity

usdgIdentityReviewCoverage.honestBoundary: the Manager published USDG-anchored loops that carry the identity value exactly, but the review selection did not pick any of them, so the identity is proved on the published loops rather than on a review row; the review-level count is reported as it is and is not claimed as reviewed

items.title: the review's borrow principal, fee, gas and signed PnL use one auditable unit, and the actual review raw fields are preserved for audit

preservedRawFields.signed_pnl_raw: the signed hex profit in the borrow token's raw units
preservedRawFields.signed_pnl_amount: the same profit in human units
preservedRawFields.signed_pnl_unit: the unit label of the raw field
preservedRawFields.static_preview_json.bestAmountCalculatio: the ladder: amountRaw, amount, borrowAmount, profit, profitAmount, requestedAmount and initialProbeAmount
preservedRawFields.manager_v4_closed_loops.borrow_token_usd: the value of one whole borrow token in raw USDG units
preservedRawFields.manager_v4_closed_loops.borrow_token_dec: the decimals of the borrow token
preservedRawFields.manager_v4_closed_loops.cross_tick_revie: the economic threshold in raw USDG units

items.note: the fee is a pool parameter on the 1e-6 scale and the gas is a separate quoter word, so neither is mixed into the PnL unit; the PnL is the kernel's net borrow-token profit

items.title: the mainnet coverage is re-checked against a fresh Manager state, and the same validation runs on the testnet once the Manager has loops there; coverage never substitutes for the real per-review unit check

stateDetail.unmet: the testnet Manager has not published a closed loop, so the Manager-side USDG valuation path cannot be exercised there; the root cause is tracked by TASK-147 and its fix needs an authorized write, so this half is reported as unmeasured rather than passed

signedPnlUnitCheck.note: the testnet per-review unit contract IS verified on the reviews that exist: every signed PnL raw value divided by the library decimals of its borrow token reproduces the stored human amount

managerValuationPath.note: the Manager resolves the USDG token through token_library_catalog, and the testnet catalog does admit USDG with six decimals, so the anchor identity would resolve there.  What is missing is a materialised closed loop: the Manager has published no loop, so the valuation path never runs and no loop-level valuation row exists to check.  The testnet token_usdg_valuations table is a DIFFERENT producer (the on-chain quoter) and it uses a 1e18 scale, so it is not evidence for the Manager's 1e6 raw-USDG unit

items.note: the coverage numbers are reported next to the per-review unit checks and never instead of them

items.title: a token without a usable price or decimals is reported as a coverage gap - never a zero rate and never a default rate

coverageGapLoops.note: no USDG route, so no valuation is published; the kernel fails closed instead of using a default rate
no USDG route, so no valuation is published; the kernel fails closed instead of using a default rate

items.note: the gap is carried as an absent valuation, so the kernel's cross-tick initialization returns 'cross_tick_inputs_unavailable' and the measured single-tick result is preserved

usdgIdentity.note: the USDG anchor is the stablecoin unit identity (10^usdg_decimals raw USDG); the kernel's identity_valuation returns it before any pool is consulted.  The identity is verified on every USDG-anchored loop the Manager published; the review selection did not pick a USDG-anchored loop, so the review-level count is reported separately instead of being claimed as reviewed
